instruction: A crisp athletic photograph captures a medium shot in a boxing gym. On the left, the blonde woman in the purple cropped hoodie (R2) stands in a boxing stance, throwing a straight punch with her brown boxing glove. On the right, the black man in the orange beanie (R1) stands defensively, raising his hands to block the punch near his face. The background consists of a gray concrete wall with a painted boxer silhouette and a black punching bag hanging on the left. The scene is lit with bright, neutral gym lighting, emphasizing their dynamic poses and athletic training session.
